name: Ragtop
author: Stan Clemance
description: Tablet mode plus an on-screen keyboard (OSK). Inherits Omarchy themes, with keycaps in Mobile, 60%, 75% or 80% tenkeyless (TKL). Auto-resize and auto-rotate via the accelerometer, or pick what you like and lock the orientation. It follows your layout down to dead keys and AltGr. Fold or detach a convertible 2-in-1 and it auto-detects notebook or tablet mode. Use it by touchscreen or by mouse for kiosks. A touch interface resizes, moves and swaps Omarchy tiles. Tested on Yoga and Surface.

barWidget.description: The on-screen keyboard and screen rotation, always in the bar, plus tiling mode while the machine is a tablet
